text:
carla: Quick sync — we need a compact fallback compatibility matrix for tiered routing. I'm seeing 3 mismatch classes: tokenizer, effective context, tool-calling parity.

ben: Totally. Can you paste the current matrix? :eyes: 

dinesh: Link to rough draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/xyz (internal)

carla: Pasted below (very rough):
```
region,tier,model_variant,tokenizer_eq,context_eq,toolcall_eq,notes
us-east,free,gptx-small,false,<=2048,false,tokenizer differs (bpe vs bpe-lite)
us-east,pro,redwood-1,true,<=4096,true,ok
eu-west,enterprise,redwood-1-quant,true,<=8192,false,tool-call missing arg typing
ap-south,pro,redwood-alt,false,<=2048,false,kv-cache mismatch
```

eva: For routing we need deterministic fallback rules: prefer same tokenizer, then context >= request, then toolcall parity. Otherwise escalate to a higher-tier compute variant if quota allows.

ben: Question — how do quotas interact? If pro falls back to enterprise variant in a region, do we bill pro or enterprise capacity? @dinesh?

dinesh: Current plan: charge based on serving variant actually used (so enterprise pricing). We should add a UI warning in console and a telemetry flag fallback_variant and charge_code.

jess: UX note: Console rollout should hide auto-fallback for free tier unless user opts in. We need a small banner: "Using fallback model for compatibility — performance/price may differ." Also add a per-route toggle in Rollouts to opt into permissive fallback.

carla: Telemetry metrics to add: fallback_count, fallback_reason (tokenizer/context/toolcall), latency_delta_ms, tokens_served_by_variant, quota_override=true/false.

deploy-bot: deployment:compat-matrix v1 -> staged in eng-nonprod at 2063456840 :rocket: 

ben: One more API debate — do we add `fallback_policy` to API v2 or make it separate routing config? I'm leaning to routing config so it's not per-request noise.

eva: routing config + per-request header override (x-rw-allow-fallback) for devs testing.

carla: Ok action items:
- dinesh: add telemetry flags + charge_code (PR)
- jess: UX mock for console banner/route toggle
- ben: proposal to add routing config schema change (RFC)
- eva: update router logic to prefer tokenizer parity first

carla: tagging follow-up meeting next Tue 11am. :calendar:
